article.title: Netanyahu is embracing Israel’s isolation
article.author: Jamal Zakkout
article.content: Netanyahu’s speech at the UN General Assembly was not directed at the world, but Israelis. He was trying to convince them that Israel doesn’t need to change, as long as it stands united against the world — and lives by the sword.
